_comment: Copied into a target repo at onboarding as .claude/settings.json by scripts/install-repo-settings.mjs — see engineering/docs/managed-settings.md. Do not hand-edit the __ENGINEERING_HOOKS_DIR__ placeholders; the installer resolves them to this machine's actual engineering/hooks checkout path. Commit the resulting .claude/settings.json so every clone gets the plan gate and test lock with no install step — check the target repo's own .gitignore does not exclude .claude/ first, or the commit will silently do nothing.
